title: fix: filter `id` field from RelatedList auto-generated columns
body:
CI failure: `RelatedList.test.tsx` — auto-generated columns from object schema were not excluding the `id` field.

- The column filter in `RelatedList.tsx` only excluded `_`-prefixed fields; added `id` exclusion to match expected behavior

```typescript
// Before
.filter(([key]) => !key.startsWith('_'))

// After
.filter(([key]) => !key.startsWith('_') && key !== 'id')
```
